AI industry news aggregation from curated RSS feeds. Catches model releases from major labs.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the AI News Skill.
- Fetches and summarizes AI industry news from 15 curated RSS feeds, covering major model releases and developments.
- Categorizes news into Model Releases, Research, Industry, Product, and Opinion.
- Supports deduplication and time-based filtering (daily or weekly briefings).
- Optional save-to-file feature for news briefings and reference links.
- Handles feed errors gracefully and notes any coverage gaps (e.g., Chinese AI labs).
